translated: Wait, you don't think I have any?
Well, I have them too, but how should I put it... Whether we're working together or all of Momojan is out for a meal,
I always feel so at ease because Yui-chan is so consistent.
especially when we were together for the Momojan Thanksgiving event...
We're pretty much always on stage together, aren't we?

I really felt that from you, so I realized I haven't actually seen you get anxious or depressed very often.
I'm sure all sorts of things happen between the four of us.
But it just made me curious.
I guess I try to be reliable.
